observations.label: Bitwise chunk CRC baseline

before.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

after.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

observations.boundary: Warm RGBA input to complete owned PNG: fresh managed MemoryStream (creation, growth, encode and disposal included; no redundant ToArray); native codec context/packet wrapper reused, real independently owned packet acquisition, encode and release included. Both level 6/filter None. For RGBA16, native LE-to-BE full-frame sample conversion runs inside every operation, using a reused admitted prepared frame; managed conversion/row storage is included in public EncodePng. IPC, file IO, hashes and validation excluded.

runtime.jitPolicy: Tiered compilation disabled; fully optimized JIT before measurement
